result.summary: Found 1 major layout issue in the bottom navigation bar where icons overlap with the system home indicator.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar lacks sufficient bottom safe-area padding, causing the navigation icons (Home, Search, Orders, Profile) to sit too low and overlap with the system home indicator bar.
issues.suggestion: Add proper bottom safe-area inset padding to the bottom navigation bar so that the icons are vertically centered above the system home indicator without overlapping.
